messages:
Maya (release-lead): quick callout 0:00-20:10 UTC mini-window to push rti:v2.3.2 and router header tweak. please ack and surface any critical blockers.
Omar (runtime): ack. I'll pin rti:v2.3.2 for the window and freeze autoscale at min=4. I'll also turn off the experimental batcher.
Liu (router): ack. We'll do header-toggle -> v4-compat and a linear ramp: 0 -> 25 -> 60 -> 100 over 8m. hold if p95 > 500ms.
Nora (console): ack. Console will show a banner "Deploy in progress - model config locked" and disable manual switching. I'll add the rollback snippet to the runbook.
Maya (release-lead): rollback triggers: +4% relative error rate OR p99 > 900ms sustained for 90s. Ash, can you take primary pager?
Ash (oncall): on it. I'll watch the alert channels and confirm any auto-rollback within 2m.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary: service=runtime, variant=rti:v2.3.2, canary_pct=25, window=6m (ts=1778904380).
Omar (runtime): smoke test commands: 
```
curl -I -H "x-variant: rti-v2.3.2" https://api.internal/health || true
kubectl get pods -l app=rti -n runtime -o wide
```
Liu (router): router command for ops run: 
```
routerctl traffic-shift --service runtime --target v4-compat --pct 25
```
Nora (console): release notes checklist: pinned image, router header change, console lock, dashboards + rollback steps, CS heads-up. Draft pushed.
Priya (product): small ask 0s for CS: mention "no change to user prompts/outputs" so CS can reassure integrators.
Maya (release-lead): sounds good. adding to notes.
deploy-bot: canary started: runtime rti:v2.3.2 at 25% (ts=1778904405). Monitoring hooks enabled.
Ash (oncall): initial metrics: p50=48ms, p95=220ms, errors +0.1%. No alerts.
Omar (runtime): logs look clean. disabled experimental batcher as planned. KV cache stable.
Liu (router): router CPUs +2%, no unusual error spikes. Proceed to 60% in 3m unless we see drift.
deploy-bot: ramp to 60% completed (ts=1778904480).
Ash (oncall): small p95 bump to 420ms for 40s, back to baseline. No sustained breach.
Priya (product): CS notified. Small thread with them about the banner copy done.
Nora (console): holding on unpin until we confirm 10m stable post-full rollout. Runbook updated with unpin steps.
Maya (release-lead): decision: if 10m after 100% stay green we'll unpin. Otherwise keep pinned and schedule follow-up.
deploy-bot: full rollout: runtime -> rti:v2.3.2 -> 100% (ts=1778904555).
Omar (runtime): rolling update completed. watching for KV pressure.
Liu (router): header flag at v4-compat for all routes. Ready to revert if needed.
Ash (oncall): monitoring nominal. no rollback. alerts quiet.
Maya (release-lead): excellent. post-deploy: Nora will lift console lock in 30m and publish short deploy summary. We'll only open a postmortem if customer-facing errors >1% in 24h.
Nora (console): will lift lock and update changelog. Thanks team. :tada:
